method.feature: Researcher-selected phrase aliases, informed by pilot; not an exhaustive vocabulary or theme classifier
method.vector: log TF × smoothed IDF, L2-normalized within each document over retained phrase features; cosine between phrase columns
method.edge: same-record weighted association, not provider or causal tie
method.default: cosine >= 0.12; >=25 shared rows; union of top-four neighbor lists; isolated phrases hidden by default
method.communities: greedy modularity on default displayed graph excluding isolates; colors are exploratory, not themes
method.prefix: remove content before explicit this standard/condition was/is not met; quoted policies may remain
method.cohort: purpose views use mutually exclusive sampling stratum; original overlapping flags retained in corpus

hospiceMethod.identity: Assigned source CCN only; Pending identities excluded from hospice counts and edges, retained in record views.
hospiceMethod.edge: Binary provider-by-phrase incidence. Cosine = shared hospices / sqrt(hospices mentioning A * hospices mentioning B). Phrases may occur in different records and surveys at the same hospice.
hospiceMethod.severity: Any phrase-matching row for a hospice flagged IJ Yes; denominator includes hospices with at least one known Yes/No flag in matching rows. All-missing and partial-missing counts shown separately. Condition association is separate, not a composite severity score.
hospiceMethod.repeat: Same phrase at the same assigned CCN on at least two distinct survey-end dates within the selected view. May include follow-up recitations, copied text, or related surveys. Also report repeats on non-follow-up dates only.
hospiceMethod.interpretation: Text associations, not provider ties, independent failure events, validated themes, or national prevalence. Distinct CCNs do not establish distinct corporate owners.
